live_psp_caveat: Live card, wallet, and mobile-money collection requires your organisation to complete merchant onboarding with your chosen payment service provider (PSP). RunMyCampus ships product-side rails and reconciliation workflows; PSP contracts, production API keys, webhooks, and settlement accounts are external prerequisites — not unlimited or automatic.

packages.label: Starter
packages.offline_support: Offline capture and sync where modules support it; conflict resolution in-product.
packages.payment_support: Invoicing and receipt capture in-product; live PSP rails after external merchant setup (see caveat).
packages.marketplace_access: Browse and install approved tenant-scoped apps where plan allows.
packages.implementation_support: Self-serve plus documentation; optional guided kickoff (commercial).
packages.support_sla_wording: Standard business-hours support; severity-based response targets per contract (not unlimited).

packages.label: Growth
packages.offline_support: Full offline-first paths for supported attendance and fee workflows.
packages.payment_support: Multi-rail readiness by region; live PSP still requires external onboarding (see caveat).
packages.marketplace_access: Expanded catalog subject to policy and vetting.
packages.implementation_support: Named implementation window; data migration checklist.
packages.support_sla_wording: Enhanced support tier available; exact SLA in order form (no fake unlimited claims).

packages.label: Professional
packages.offline_support: Same as Growth with operator playbooks for conflict handling.
packages.payment_support: Orchestrated payment UX; PSP health snapshots; external credentials still required for live money movement.
packages.implementation_support: Structured onboarding factory + command-center checklists in-product.
packages.support_sla_wording: Priority queue; named CSM optional — terms in contract.

packages.label: Enterprise
packages.offline_support: Enterprise offline and audit expectations documented in security packet request.
packages.payment_support: Multi-entity finance; PSP still external for settlement (see caveat).
packages.implementation_support: Enterprise implementation playbook + weekly checkpoint template.
packages.support_sla_wording: Negotiated SLA; severity matrix in schedule — not a blanket unlimited promise.

packages.label: Network / Multi-campus
packages.offline_support: Per-campus offline with group-level monitoring hooks where deployed.
packages.payment_support: Campus-level PSP configuration; group finance rollups — external PSP per campus or group per your PSP agreements.
packages.support_sla_wording: Network support model defined in MSA — explicit caps, not unlimited.
